title: I tried the top 8 AI marketing tools for small business in 2026: Here's what works | eesel AI

facts.fact: Eesel AI, the page's publisher, says its blog writer took its own site from 700 impressions per day to 750,000 in three months (vendor claim).
facts.quote: We went from 700 impressions per day to 750,000 in just three months by publishing high-quality, optimized content at scale.

facts.fact: A 2024 Semrush report, cited by the page, found that 68% of businesses see a higher return on investment after using AI for content marketing (third-party claim).
facts.quote: found that 68% of businesses see a higher return on investment after using AI for content marketing

facts.fact: The page's starting-price table lists Jasper at $59/month billed annually, with a 7-day free trial.
The page's starting-price table lists Flodesk Studio as free during beta.
The page's starting-price table lists Canva at $120 per year, with a free plan available.
The page's starting-price table lists Mailchimp at $13 per month, with a free plan for up to 250 contacts.
The page's starting-price table lists Surfer SEO at $79 per month billed annually, with no free trial.
The page's starting-price table lists ChatGPT Plus at $20 per month, with a free version available.
